comment: v18 = v16 final + cold-open intro + per-hit on-screen-time extensions. Built NON-DESTRUCTIVELY by concat from the portrait working source + v16. Each insert goes at a v16 OUTPUT-timeline position that is a segment boundary BETWEEN two transitions, so both card slides stay 100% intact. Extension clips are pulled from the portrait source (same timeline as the 1080p the user references, but pre-cropped to 1080x1920 with baked pans = matches v16 framing).

build.method: Full reconstruction from the portrait source: rebuild every v16 segment from its cut.json src-window (so v16's own cuts/skips/slides are reproduced exactly), apply the 6 hit mods, prepend the 4 intro clips, concat-filter re-encode at 60fps. NO rendered-v16 extracts are used, so there is zero v16-OUT-time vs portrait-src-time drift anywhere (this is what caused the KC mid-slide glitch when mixing).

speedPass.reason: Final must be UNDER 3:00 (YouTube Short). Full-speed v18 was 3:38.6.
speedPass.rule: 1x (full speed) for: all 6 hits + every cardInPack===3. 1.5x for everything else (non-hit, non-3rd cards). Intro stays 1x (not a card).
speedPass.note: User assumed all hits are 3rd cards, but per catalog cardInPack: Norton(c4), Gunner(c4), Eric(c4) are 4th cards - kept 1x anyway because they are hits. KC's Troy clip (c2) is sped 1.5x and split from the KC ext (1x) at the reveal point 585.15 (same source pt, no skip). Eric merge stays 1x (Jayden is c3, Eric is hit).

speedPass.speedFilter: per clip: setpts=(PTS-STARTPTS)/speed,fps=60,setsar=1 (drops frames to hold 60fps; no audio)
speedPass.hitShave: Trimmed the TAIL of each hit's extension to bank time for the end recap + pack-return room. Royer ext 174->172 (-2s total; the extra 1s lets the recap start at video-end so the final card Jaden Nixon is fully visible). Norton 424->423, KC 591->590, Gunner 842->841, Eric 1069->1068. Luke Altmyer NOT shaved. Under-3 cut now 2:53.29.
speedPass.positionsExport: gen-v18-speed.mjs also writes scratch/v18-card-positions.json from the SAME clip list it renders -> overlay chip timing always matches the cut (single source of truth).

renderNotes: DRIFT WARNING: do NOT splice the portrait source onto a v16 extract addressed by computed OUT-time in the MIDDLE of a slide motion — accumulated frame-rounding between v16's real frames and computed OUT-time causes a few-frame position jump (hit on KC at first pass). Where an extension is continuous with the transition-IN slide (Royer, KC), pull [transition-in card's whole segment + extension] as ONE continuous portrait extract so the slide->reveal->hold never crosses a splice. Held-to-held match cuts and hard cuts tolerate the drift fine. Cleanest full-v18 build = reconstruct entirely from the portrait source via the cut's segment src-times + extensions (avoid mixing rendered-v16 OUT-time with portrait src-time).
